features.title: Pipeline metrics on asdd status
features.user_visible_behavior: asdd status --metrics shows lite share, escalation rate, phase durations, stop-FAIL counts, and open patterns; --json prints the object.
features.evidence: Re-verified after the 3.11.0 version bump and the playbook (slice kit-playbook): `node --test cli/src/harness/pipeline-metrics.test.mjs` exits 0.

features.title: init-flow and Spec Kit guide
features.user_visible_behavior: asdd init-flow scaffolds a lite slice to a green asdd check; cli/docs/guides/spec-kit-to-asdd.md maps Spec Kit to ASDD.
features.evidence: Re-verified after the 3.11.0 version bump and the playbook (slice kit-playbook): `node --test cli/src/harness/init-flow.test.mjs && test -f cli/docs/guides/spec-kit-to-asdd.md && grep -q "Spec Kit" cli/docs/guides/spec-kit-to-asdd.md` exits 0.
